stem: What percentage of all illnesses in children under 5 years is accounted for by respiratory illnesses?
explanation: Respiratory illnesses account for 50% of all illnesses in children under 5 years.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because 30% is lower than the proportion attributed to respiratory illnesses in this age group.
optionExplanations.B: Correct because respiratory illnesses account for half of all illnesses in children under 5 years.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because 75% overestimates the share of all childhood illnesses due to respiratory causes.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because 90% is far higher than the documented contribution of respiratory illnesses in this age group.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because 95% greatly overstates the proportion of all illnesses caused by respiratory conditions.

source.hint: Recall the statistic provided for the youngest age group mentioned in the epidemiology section.
